
The actual data (i.e. sequenced reads) are stored on the Euler HPC cluster.

To access the data, do the following:
- open a terminal (e.g. in jupyterhub)
- type 'ssh <yourethusername>@euler.ethz.ch'
- when prompted to enter the password, enter your eth password (you won't see what you're typing)
--> you should now be in on the Euler HPC cluster
- go to the directory of this project by typing 'cd ~/../../scratch/tpayer/MicroOdyssey/'
- to specifically see the dataset, go to the directory of the dataset by typing 'cd data/raw'
